📖 How to use

  1. Give the event a name.
  2. Pick the future date and time.
  3. Press Start countdown.
  4. Watch the days, hours, minutes and seconds tick down live.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How often does the countdown update?

Every second with setInterval, from your device clock. It keeps ticking while the tab is open and stops at zero.

What if the date is in the past?

It shows a friendly message that the date has passed, instead of negative numbers.

Does it send reminders?

No — it counts down in your browser only. Close the tab and it stops; nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
